Title: Simplified Chinese language support now available in Azure Cognitive Services Computer Vision public preview

Body.Content:
Simplified Chinese language support is now available in Read 3.1 public preview in Computer Vision, part of Azure Cognitive Services.

Use the Read API to integrate Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for English, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese (public preview), and Spanish languages.

See the Read API overview to learn more. Learn more about Read API v3.1 Public Preview
